title_en: Duplex penthouse in Moinhos de Vento
summary_en: Private terrace, all-day natural light and warm wood finishes.
description_en: A generous duplex layout designed for hosting. The private terrace has room for lounging and dining, with open views over the neighbourhood. The main suite occupies the upper floor, with a walk-in closet and bathtub.

summary_en: Recently renovated, two bedrooms and a balcony that works as a study.
description_en: Renovated apartment with custom joinery and designed lighting. The balcony is integrated into the living room and now works as a study. Building with 24-hour concierge and one covered parking space.

summary_en: Move-in ready, two blocks from Redenção park and downtown.
description_en: Furnished studio with a smart layout and good natural light. Compact equipped kitchen and floor-to-ceiling storage. Walkable location with grocery, coffee and transport on the same street.

summary_en: Four bedrooms, mature garden and a back area with a barbecue.
description_en: Street-facing house with generous setbacks and a mature garden. The living room opens to the outdoor area through glass doors. At the back, a covered barbecue and bicycle storage.

summary_en: Three bedrooms, two of them en-suite, on a tree-lined street.
description_en: A traditional floor plan with well-separated rooms and high ceilings. The living area has windows on two sides and fits both dining and lounge. Building with two lifts and concierge.

title_en: Commercial unit in Moinhos de Vento
summary_en: Full floor with reception, two rooms and a kitchenette, in an office address.
description_en: Commercial suite with an independent entrance and reception. Two enclosed rooms and an open area that fits six workstations. Air conditioning installed and fibre-ready.

summary_en: Heated pool, four suites and views over the Guaíba.
description_en: A triplex penthouse with three levels connected by a sculptural staircase and a private lift. The outdoor area has a heated pool, deck and support kitchen. Views open over the river and the city.

summary_en: Two bedrooms, one parking space and a strong area-to-price ratio.
description_en: A practical layout with no wasted corridors. The kitchen opens to the living room and has a breakfast counter. Building with lift and concierge, minutes from downtown.

summary_en: Original structure preserved, new systems and a courtyard with a centenary tree.
description_en: A carefully renovated house: restored window frames and new electrical and plumbing systems. The central courtyard organises circulation and brings light into every room. Large kitchen with an island.

summary_en: A well-resolved 32 sqm, furnished, five minutes from the park.
description_en: A studio with custom joinery that solves kitchen, storage and bed. Bathroom with a glass shower and natural ventilation. Small building with few units per floor.

summary_en: 360 sqm, paved street frontage and feasibility for two units.
description_en: A flat, dry plot with 12 metres of street frontage. The neighbourhood is established and residential, with shops a few blocks away. Clean documentation with no pending issues.

summary_en: Two bedrooms, a balcony and park views.
description_en: An apartment with a balcony facing the park and good cross-ventilation. Living room with space for a home office and a separate kitchen. One covered space and bike storage in the building.

title_en: Penthouse with terrace in Bela Vista
summary_en: Three suites and a 40 sqm terrace facing the sunset.
description_en: A penthouse with a two-zone living room and an ethanol fireplace. The terrace has water and gas points, ready for an outdoor kitchen. All three suites have custom wardrobes.

summary_en: Four bedrooms, two floors and parking for two cars.
description_en: A house with a preserved facade and updated interior. Social areas are on the ground floor, opening to the backyard. Upstairs, four bedrooms, one of them en-suite.

title_en: Office in a historic building downtown
summary_en: High ceilings, large windows and street views.
description_en: An office in a restored building, with a lift and a preserved entrance hall. The space fits four workstations and a meeting table. Ideal for a studio, office or client-facing practice.

summary_en: Two bedrooms, a balcony and open river views.
description_en: A high-floor apartment with a balcony facing the river. The living room has good depth and fits both lounge and dining. Building with concierge and one parking space.
